focus: Kael eases the loose flagstone up without letting it grind against its neighbours.
pressure: Any noise that carries below might wake whatever is sealed there.
stakes: What is hidden under the abbot's desk, or being heard finding it.

effects.why: the flagstone grinds and Kael has to force it the rest of the way

action.risk: the grinding stone reaches whatever is sealed below

focus: Kael drives the bloated rat off the cloister stair before it can double back on him.
pressure: It has grown fat on the dead garden and does not scare off easily.
stakes: The stair down, or a bite worth remembering.

effects.why: the stair down is finally clear of the rat

effects.text: (condition) Reeling, and gives Kael a wide berth before it comes on again.
